reviewType: Independent revised runtime/contract design re-review; not implementation QA/PO/lifecycle verdict
summary: R1 resolves the central architecture: pre-effect immutable evidence and independent validation basis, real account SPI/startup, explicit dual-family contracts, preserved fill/select primitives and hash algorithms, fresh private values, and correct historical-learning versus execution compatibility separation. Several exact contract joins still contradict the actual source or omit data required by normal execution. These are small bounded design corrections, not a change of architecture or a request for later account/benchmark implementation.

priorFindingDisposition.evidence: D2/D3 capture original sanitized observation/preparation facts before they are overwritten and join them atomically to actual admissions; C4/C5 independently supplied basis allows Node guard/input derivation. R1-001 below fixes the accepted-plan import shape, which currently rejects real allocated plans.

C1-C9 now define closed types, separate composite caps, discriminators and handshakes. R1-002 and R1-005 identify missing normal job configuration and explicit IPC status/control/unknown-evidence semantics.

C6 defines bounded sensitive one-use handle, neutral Java authorize/issue/current SPI, worker consume/prepare/apply/dispose, actual child entry injection and fail-closed default. C8 policy snapshot still cannot represent the actual approved application/region grants; see R1-003. No demand to implement007 connectivity.
C8 and main section7 correctly distinguish native pointer/key from actual isolated fill/select primitives, preserving retained-target checks, event behavior and post-input uncertainty.

C2-C4 preserve ordered-sourceHash, existing ledger-array admissionProvenanceHash, value-free cfg-ID/name mapping and separately named publicationEvidenceHash. C9 fixed byte/digest examples agree. R1-004 addresses mutable lease timestamps in snapshot identity rather than those canonical algorithms.

findings.finding: The closed imported type says source-selection.schema.json with the sole extension obligationId, and claims this is the actual persisted V32 shape. Actual GuidedDependencyPlanner.allocate adds bindingId to each need before the allocated plan is persisted; the source-selection needs object is additionalProperties=false and has no bindingId. Any completed workflow with implicit dataflow therefore cannot be represented in the declared ValidationBasis or hashed as its actual persisted translationPlan.
findings.necessaryChange: Define a closed accepted allocated-need extension with the existing needId/producerStepId/consumers plus the trusted bindingId (required in final accepted allocated plan). Keep obligationId extension too. Hash the actual immutable stored plan, including its trusted allocations; never strip bindingId merely to make the model-output schema pass. Validate each bindingId bidirectionally against original allocation/producer/consumer records.
testOracles: Take an actual post-bootstrap accepted plan with one implicit need and its persisted bindingId; the closed basis accepts it and H(translationPlan) equals stored translationHash.
Remove/change/duplicate that bindingId or bind it to another original allocation; both Java and Node refuse despite recomputed artifact-local hashes.

findings.finding: ObservedJob carries artifact, inputs, handle, timeouts and recording geometry, but omits Configuration. Artifact has configurationHash only. Launch2 requires viewport, and normal recorded launch also needs the frozen browser/configuration semantics. Recording dimensions are not the authored viewport. The runner cannot reconstruct the authorized viewport/waitStrategy or recompute configurationHash from the declared job.
findings.necessaryChange: Include the closed C2 Configuration in ObservedJob (or an equivalent explicitly bound complete execution configuration). Require H(configuration)=artifact.configurationHash and equality with the accepted immutable revision/configuration identity before admission/launch. Define viewport/runtime/recording projection explicitly, preserving distinction between viewport and recording size and existing runtime ceilings; no reverse-hash reconstruction or default substitution.
testOracles: Publish with viewport deliberately different from recording geometry; actual observed child gets the exact viewport and produces correctly timed video.
Change viewport, browser, environment or waitStrategy while preserving artifactHash; refuse configurationHash/binding mismatch before browser.
No hidden legacy/default configuration fallback in observed mode.

findings.finding: The closed policy has only rules {ruleId,origin,locator,recipe}. It has no application/region grant selector, allowStructuralDiscovery or actual optional field override representation. Existing collector authorization uses ObservationApplicationPolicy.readGrants with application/role region, visibleText permission, control-value type sets and independently optional testId overrides. The new shape does not specify a semantics-preserving mapping and can reintroduce mandatory per-control mappings or flatten away live region membership.
findings.necessaryChange: Freeze a bounded snapshot/adapter mapping that preserves the existing structural permission, application/region read-grant union, type allowlists, optional exact overrides and deny/conflict precedence. Prefer projecting the existing actual policy types into the trusted wire snapshot; do not synthesize per-control grants from learned artifact locators. currentPolicyHash must cover the effective region/type/override policy used by the child. Keep pure structural discovery insufficient for reads.
testOracles: Actual ordinary replay of a no-testId/no-per-control source and labelled consumer using one application/region grant, preserving fresh-value server receipts.
No-grant, moved-outside-region, duplicate region, hidden/password/sensitive descendant and narrower structuralOnly override refuse.
Changing only region anchor/type allowlist/override changes effective policy identity or refuses current-policy compatibility; no stale flattened authorization.

findings.area: C4/D3 snapshotHash and D4/D6 final CAS
findings.finding: snapshotHash includes owner.leaseExpiresAt, and D3/D6 call for recomputing it from current owner/lease. The real worker renews a live same-owner lease in place about every10s. A valid15s validator call or fresh Core call can therefore be invalidated solely by an unrelated successful heartbeat, spending the three session-wide attempts with no evidence/fence change.
findings.necessaryChange: Distinguish the captured validation authorization deadline from current lease liveness. Freeze the captured deadline in the attempt/snapshot identity and validate response/commit before that original deadline, while rechecking current same owner/fence and an unexpired current lease; do not rehash a benign later renewal timestamp as changed evidence. Alternatively define an equally precise stable snapshot rule. A renewal must not extend a claimed validation deadline or revive an expired attempt.
testOracles: Hold validation across an actual same-fence renewal while remaining inside original claim deadline; publication can commit with one validator send and unchanged evidence identity.
Changed fence/owner, shortened or expired authority, response after original claim deadline, cancellation and source/evidence change still refuse; renewal cannot revive the attempt.

findings.finding: StepFinished2 exposes only ok/errorCode/atMs, with no defined SKIPPED representation; Result2.recording.bytes is nonnullable although the actual recording pipeline reports null for unavailable/unknown size; no common stop or Stop2 frame is defined. These may be implemented compatibly, but the claimed complete closed IPC currently leaves cancellation/skipped-step/evidence mapping to invention.
findings.necessaryChange: Specify an unambiguous PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED mapping (prefer explicit status and nullable skipped timings, or exact documented state-dependent mapping), preserve unknown recording size as null instead of fabricated0, and explicitly retain the closed common {kind:stop} command for both per-run channels or define Stop2. Define the paired recording/run clock origin before account apply and never reset it when Ready2 is finally sent.
testOracles: First operation fails or cancels, later steps are honestly SKIPPED with existing null-timing semantics, never false assertion failures.
Recording unavailable/inspection failure retains unknown byte count and correct evidence state/partial flag.
Account apply deliberately delays several seconds; video seek/step time remains aligned to recording context origin.
Parent stop/drain/deadline terminates observed child using the exact declared control frame without changing legacy behavior.

findings.finding: C7 says the new /internal/studio/executions/{id}/observed-admission uses existing mTLS runner authentication. Actual ordinary /internal/** chain uses ServiceIdentityAuthenticationFilter with a static configured service token; verified-cert/JWT checking lives in GuidedInternalSecurity on guided-only matchers. No ordinary security configuration/filter path is reserved in the152 list. The claim of an already-present mTLS guard at this new path is not source-backed.
findings.necessaryChange: Name the actual identity/TLS enforcement for the new observed-admission route. Either explicitly use the existing ordinary restricted service identity with the real deployment TLS boundary and describe its trust limit, or add a narrowly scoped verified mTLS/service-auth guard for the new route and reserve its production/test paths. Preserve v1 callbacks. Do not claim mTLS/JWT enforcement based on HTTPS/headers or the unrelated guided chain.
testOracles: Exercise the actual new HTTP security chain with missing/wrong service identity and, if mTLS is required, missing/unverified/wrong certificate.
A valid guided-only credential does not accidentally bypass the observed execution actor/attempt checks; legacy callback auth behavior remains unchanged.

mandatoryClarificationsAndImplementation.condition: D2 says initialBlank has null observation and target. Preserve the imported Action2 page target {kind:page,documentId,generation}; only the observation/node fact is absent. Do not implement a null proposal.target that contradicts the unchanged bridge schema.

Define a total deterministic ordering for mixed input recipes and ties: source-step position, recipe-kind rank, source span start/end or cfg referenceId, slot/kind and stable inputId as needed. C3 first-position/start-or-referenceId alone is not a total order when spans start together or one source step has both recipe kinds. Publish vectors for both lowerers.

Freeze collector actionable as the recorded fact; do not newly require observation.actionable=true for every mutator. Current collector marks div[role=button] and hoverable text as non-actionable in that metadata while validateInvocation/native dispatch may legitimately execute them. Live operation-specific compatibility/hit/focus/disabled checks remain authoritative in addition to exact recorded-fact equality.

Input values and opaque account handles belong only to the explicit ephemeral job/child channels. Child graph starts empty; no RuntimeBinding can carry old availability/admission/context/fence/value. Parent must validate each supplied input ID against the immutable recipe step/kind/slot, and the typed child projection must retain enough nonsecret metadata to recheck its declared argument placements. No original source/whole artifact is needed or permitted in IPC.

Account registry selection/injection is trusted compiled/startup wiring in the actual child entry; provider objects/functions/modules cannot be serialized through job/IPC. consume/prepare before browser, same-context apply once, dispose on every exit and unknown consume/apply refusal remain required. Only007 connectivity implementation stays unavailable.

Bind the supported profile catalog to the actual schema/reference bundle and executable image/Chromium checks in build/runtime records. The closed Profile fields alone do not contain those hashes/build IDs; document/test the trusted catalog association so copied catalog strings or stale dist/schema bundles cannot claim support. Keep these execution/proof algorithm identities distinct from learning model/provider/prompt/result-format pins.

Retain C1 whole-serialization byte caps at all receiving/sending boundaries, before parse/traversal/spawn. After adding missing Configuration/policy fields, re-evaluate composed fits. All imported closed schemas, including learned-plan conditionals, must be enforced by the actual packaged observed validator, not only a build checker.

Treat providerModel/response modelVersion truthfully. Existing saved provenance supplies schema/provider-shape/output-contract pins; do not invent an unrecorded historical provider-returned version from current configuration. If a known configured model label is retained, keep it historical only and outside required replay compatibility.

historicalVersusExecutionAssessment.reason: LearningProvenance is bound in basis/publicationEvidenceHash and is not compared with current prompt/model/provider/public-result defaults during replay readiness. Profile contains execution/proof algorithm versions. Historical proof decoder support is checked for publication; later compatible replay does not request its private historical basis. Revocation requires explicit catalog policy, not accidental current-model mismatch.
requiredOracles: Change only current guided prompt/provider response schema/API result-format defaults while keeping the saved artifact and supported execution/proof catalog unchanged: saved replay remains ready and executes with zero gateway calls.
An explicitly revoked/unsupported execution or proof algorithm/catalog, changed browser/package compatibility or wrong schema bundle refuses before browser without rewriting historical provenance.

independentEvidenceAssessment.reason: D2 captures original sanitized observations and full proof/proposal associations before effects; D3 reads original rows independently; C4 supplies historical node/document/generation identities only to pure validation and derives stable guards/recipes/graph from them. Basis hashes bind claim/verdict/final CAS. Java privately verifies authoredInputsHash while Node receives only value-free opaque reference mappings and original source for exact spans. A lowerer-produced guard no longer proves itself.
oracles: Overwrite latest progress through multiple pages, restart, and publish using each original immutable preparation snapshot; missing old facts refuse.
Mutate artifact guard/type/slot/recipe/graph and recompute local hashes while basis remains fixed: independent Node refusal.
Alter basis joins or original DB evidence after validation: snapshot/final CAS refuses.
No saved values, captured bytes, sample hashes, handles or historical execution rights in artifact executable fields, IPC graph or diagnostic channels.
